metaDescription: Order custom copper cooling sport towels with your logo. Great for gyms, tradeshows, and outdoor events. Shop now!
introHtml: Copper-infused cooling sport towels offer natural antimicrobial properties that reduce odors and bacteria growth, making them ideal for gym giveaways, corporate fitness challenges, and outdoor work crews. Unlike standard cooling towels, copper material stays fresher between uses and provides long-lasting odor control. These towels activate quickly with water and stay cool for hours, perfect for hot job sites or active events. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a durable, professional look that stands out.
